Problem.content: Penulis menilai faktor-faktor yang memengaruhi kualitas jawaban dalam sistem RAG LLM pada domain keuangan, termasuk sensitivitas terhadap kualitas retrieval dan dampak prompt.
Problem.quote: We comprehensively assess various factors that contribute to the answer generation quality in LLM RAG systems, ranging from sensitivity to retrieval quality to the impact of different prompts

Domain & Data.content: Studi menggunakan dua dataset RAG dari sektor perbankan: halaman web publik tentang produk perbankan dan panduan kebijakan internal, keduanya berbahasa Inggris.
Domain & Data.quote: Banking webpages: Public webpages with general information on banking products, and Banking policy guides: internal guides for customer service executives

RAG Method.content: Retriever menggunakan OpenAI Embeddings, dokumen dipotong menjadi chunk, dan generator berupa model LLM seperti GPT‑4 dan Llama‑2; variasi kualitas retrieval diuji dengan manipulasi list hasil retrieval.
RAG Method.quote: We sampled 800 user queries for each dataset and obtained retrieved document chunks using a retriever(OpenAI Embeddings2)

Evaluation & Metrics.content: Evaluasi mencakup kemampuan LLM mengikuti instruksi, kualitas jawaban, serta metrik ekstraktivitas, dengan perbandingan antar model seperti GPT‑4, GPT‑3.5‑Turbo, dan Llama‑2.
Evaluation & Metrics.quote: Our findings reveal that generative LLMs outperform baseline models in answer quality, even on metrics emphasizing extractiveness

Main Results.content: Optimasi retrieval terbukti penting; peningkatan recall dan precision meningkatkan kualitas jawaban, sementara LLM cenderung memberikan jawaban meski dokumen relevan tidak ada, terutama pada model kecil.
Main Results.quote: We recommend prioritizing retrieval recall, while tuning retrieval systems, as LLMs exhibit pseudo-helpfulness when relevant gold document(s) are not retrieved

Limitations.content: Penulis mengakui kurangnya investigasi sistematis pada tiap komponen RAG dan bahwa studi terbatas pada data internal serta bahasa Inggris, sehingga generalisasi masih terbatas.
Limitations.quote: there is a lack of systematic investigations of the impact of each component (retriever, prompts, models) on answer generation quality

Gap.content: Inferensi: Meskipun menilai kualitas jawaban, studi tidak mengevaluasi abstensi (menolak menjawab) ketika konteks tidak mengandung jawaban, dan tidak menggunakan dokumen perbankan berbahasa Indonesia, sehingga belum menjawab fokus penelitian tentang faithfulness dan abstention pada dokumen bahasa Indonesia.
Gap.quote: LLMs tend to provide answers even when relevant source information is missing

We observed that the generation quality is highly influenced by the qual- ity of retrieval: LLMs tend to provide answers even when relevant source information is miss- ing, a form of pseudo-helpfulness varying from responding with content present in the context that is somewhat related but not addressing the user question, to hallucinations. Main Results.text: rieved. Ad- ditionally, improving precision of retrieval, either by using re-rankers or fine-tuned retrievers, will likely improve performance as they improve the gold document(s) rank in the retrieved list. We also find RAG systems to be sensitive to the presence of distractors in the context. We find a big delta between vendor LLMs (OpenAI) and smaller scale open-source alternatives in our experiments, with respect to sensitivity to prompting, overall quality, and instruction following on a domain specific use cases. Finally, for smaller-sized LLama-2 models we recommend simple instructions as they often fail to follow longer or more complicated instruc- tions.
